name: Colette's Bed & Breakfast
description: A 3-star graded B&B in the leafy garden city suburb of Pinelands. Quiet, safe, and central — 10 minutes from the City Bowl, 15 from the airport. Perfect for medical travellers, business guests, and leisure visitors seeking a village feel with everything close by.

items.name: Ground-Level Double Room
items.description: Spacious en-suite room with double/queen bed, large bathroom with shower + bath, bar fridge, microwave, tea/coffee, Android TV with Netflix, and direct access to a small outside area.

items.name: Ground-Level Twin Room
items.description: Two single beds with adjoining private shower room, DSTV, and tea/coffee facilities. Ideal for colleagues or friends travelling together.

items.name: Open-Plan Loft One
items.description: Upstairs quirky loft with double bed, sleeper couch, workstation, integrated open-plan shower room, bar fridge, microwave, and Netflix TV.

items.name: Self-Catering Garden Cottage
items.description: King or twin beds in semi-private sleeping space, deluxe en-suite shower, fully equipped kitchen, and TV lounge with daybed.

items.name: Secure Off-Street Parking
items.description: One medium vehicle per room, behind a gated fence.

items.name: Shared Kitchenette
items.description: 24-hour access to a shared kitchenette for guests.

items.name: Garden & Braai
items.description: Relax in our garden with BBQ/braai facilities.

testimonials.text: Quiet, safe, homey, and perfectly central.
testimonials.author: TripAdvisor Review

testimonials.text: The best base for exploring Cape Town without the noise.
